name: JG Website Analytics
author: StuartCole

sections.description:
WP Website Analytics: PREMIUM ANALYTICS FOR FREE

JG Website Analytics is a free WordPress Plugin offering a product to monitor website visitors which you would normally have to pay for.
With this plugin, you can understand how many visitors you have to your website, which pages are the most frequently used, which website sent them to you and how many people are on your site NOW!
Due to adblockers and privacy browsers, a considerable amount of traffic is not reported when using third-party website traffic apps, not the case with “JG Website Analytics” you have 100% of the statistics.

Initially, my aim is to create a plugin that will provide a better experience and better results than Google Analytics, the market leader. I think I am getting there but I have a lot of enhancements still to come.
Don’t spend hours trying to use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) when you can get more useful information much quicker with JG Website Analytics!
You don’t need to pay for a third-party analytics service when you can get all the information for free!

I have a short and long version of the plugin Roadmap which I am very excited about which you can read it on our roadmap page: https://jumpinggiraffe.com/website-analytics-wordpress-plugin-roadmap/

Reporting on how your visitors use your website is only the first version of the plugin, it will do so much more in the future which will also help increase user experience for your visitors but also increase the volume of traffic to your website.

What this plugin will do

  • Record 100% of the visitors to your website
  • Remove any “personal” data including IP addresses – we don’t store who your visitors are only where they visit – GDPR
  • Easy to use overview Graph and as much detail as you would like from our flexible tables.
  • Real-time visitors, how many people are using your site right now, which pages they are on and where they came from.
  • WooCommerce Analytics: understand more about your customers.
  • The Dashboard looks great on any device!
  • All your analytics in your WordPress dashboard, no need to go to a third party site and log in to get your data!

There is no need for complicated configuration or settings to get going, as soon as the plugin is “Activated” it will start recording your visitors and you can start using JG Website Analytics.

Real Time Visitors

Find out exactly how many visitors you have on your website with our LIVE Real Time Visitors.
Did you know that Google Analytics can’t show who is on your website right now! It can only show how many visitors have come to your website in the last 30 minutes. Not very helpful.
With JG Website Analytics you can see how many people are on your site now and what pages they are looking at.

WooCommerce Analytics

JG Website Analytics will not only produce in-depth visitor analytics for your WordPress blog but also for every page of your WooCommerce e-commerce shop. A powerful tool to identify your best selling products.

Privacy Protected

We value everyone’s privacy as, well, private and that is how it should be. JG Website Analytics will not store any personal data.

Reports on 100% of your website visitors:

If you are a user of Google Analytics did you know that due to Adblockers and their software restrictions, they only reported on around 48% of live visitors. Which is just not very good, is it?
Even the best third-party analytics options available can only provide a percentage of visitors to your site.
Website Analytics from Jumping Giraffe reports on 100% of your traffic as Ad blockers do not block our JavaScript snippet.

Obviously, this is a new plugin and the start of our journey so please be kind in your reviews, if you have any questions or wish to report a bug – I would be very thankful if you did as it would help me develop a better product – please get in touch using this form:
https://jumpinggiraffe.com/contact/

Bugs

If you come across a bug in the plugin or would like to see new functionality which is not already scheduled in our Roadmap (https://jumpinggiraffe.com/website-analytics-wordpress-plugin-roadmap/), please let me know at https://jumpinggiraffe.com/contact/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload jg-website-analytics.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is JG Website Analytics from Jumping Giraffe the same as Google Analytics?

No, JG Website Analytics from Jumping Giraffe is a more reliable and easier to use alternative to Google Analytics.

Is JG Website Analytics really 100% free?

It sure is! 100% and always will be.

Who has access to my data?

All your data gathered by JG Website Analytics is stored locally on your server, nothing is shared with us or anyone.
